messages:
maria_cs: quick flag — our weekly cohort sync bumped ~600 accounts from 'at-risk' to 'healthy' overnight. digging into the audit it looks like a contact enrichment run added placeholder events for imported leads. could be inflating renewal forecasts. anyone else see this? :face_with_raised_eyebrow:

liam_platform: saw anomalies in the sync logs. enrichment job returns `engagement_stub: true` when only a single inferred event exists. our healthscorer treats any non-zero event count as positive recency.

andrew_ae: that's rough. reps are seeing numbers that don't match what they did. we should avoid surfacing these as wins in the renewal queue.

sophia_data: proposing a lightweight "probation" playbook state for newly enriched/imported accounts. rules: if source in (csv, sf_import) && inferred_only == true => set healthscore_category = "probation" and suppress outbound playbook triggers for 14 days or until verified_product_event > 0. keeps the data but stops actioning on it.

maria_cs: love that. can we also add an enrichment confidence threshold so we only mark as inferred if confidence < 0.8?

liam_platform: yes. config sample for the rule:```yaml
playbook:
  id: probation-enrich-2026-04
  preconditions:
    - source: ["csv", "salesforce_import"]
    - enrichment_confidence: "< 0.8"
    - inferred_only: true
  actions:
    - set_tag: "probation:enrichment"
    - set_health_note: "probation-enrich-automute"
    - suppress_outbound: true
    - suppress_duration_days: 14
```

sophia_data: plus add `verify_manual=true` so CS can flip the tag after manual review. we should record audit reasons in contact history.

ops-bot: dry-run complete for cohort enrichment-run-2026-04-09. cohort_size: 612 — would_be_probation: 478 (78%) — would_suppress_outbound: 478. ARR breakdown: low:<10k => 442 probation; mid:10k-100k => 30; high:>100k => 6.

andrew_ae: good to see high-ARR small. can we auto-route high-ARR (>=100k) to a manual review queue instead of auto-suppress? reps need visibility.

liam_platform: yep — add bypass condition `arr >= 100000 => route: manual_review_queue`.

sophia_data: also adding a console card for "probationed accounts" with quick actions: verify (mark product_event), request enrichment re-run, export for AE outreach.

maria_cs: checklist for rollout:
- enable dry-run in staging for 72h
- create Slack alert when probationed fraction > 50% for a cohort: `cs.playbook.probation.rate`
- add dashboard widget showing suppression impact on weekly outreach counts
- manual review flow docs for AEs

liam_platform: will push rule to staging by EOD and wire the alert. logging will include `enrichment_confidence` and `import_job_id`.

ops-bot: alert created: cs.playbook.probation.rate >= 50% -> notify #customer-success and cs-ops.

sophia_data: can we also capture a tiny sample of outbound templates suppressed so we can evaluate if any high-priority sequences were blocked?

maria_cs: yes please. aim for a 20-account sample daily. i'll coordinate with ops for the sample export and AE outreach to verify.

andrew_ae: thanks everyone, this should reduce noise for renewals. ping me when staging dry-run results are in. :pray:
